func run(label string, opts *vm.Options, script string) {
	e := env.NewEnv()
	if err := e.Define("mkerr", func(msg string) error { return errors.New(msg) }); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := e.DefineType("error", reflect.TypeOf((*error)(nil)).Elem()); err != nil {

	}
	v, err := vm.Execute(e, opts, script)
	fmt.Printf("%-38s -> v=%#v err=%v\n", label, v, err)
}
